decision.summary: No new action: Polymarket still appears to be in an abnormal post-update state, the live board is not trustworthy, cash is reported as zero, and the existing weekly position does not meet any valid management trigger.
decision.rationale: Reconciliation is clean, but this snapshot is not suitable for fresh trading decisions. The TIP explicitly notes that Polymarket is updating around 12:00 UTC, and the market data confirms that the board is still abnormal: nearly every weekly BTC market is showing distorted 50/50-style probabilities with unusable books such as 0.98 asks, while no daily April 28 board is available at all. The only live tracked position is the weekly 76k dip, now around 50%, so it is far below both partial-take-profit and full-take-profit zones, and it is also nowhere near the exceptional invalidation threshold. Account state reports zero available cash, which independently blocks any new opening action even if markets were healthy. With corrupted Polymarket pricing, no daily board, no cash, and no valid management trigger on the remaining weekly, the disciplined decision is NO_ACTION.
